description: X web conversion batches, including the documented direct API and pinned official GTM sender. Alternative event and timestamp fields are supported per conversion. Sender-profile advice does not establish receiver acceptance.

params.name: pixel_id
params.description: It is the X Pixel ID, and it travels in the path.
params.fix_hint: Put the Pixel ID in the path as `/12/measurement/conversions/{pixel_id}`.

params.name: conversion_time
params.description: X documents the conversion time as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
params.fix_hint: Send an ISO 8601 timestamp, such as `2022-02-18T01:14:00.603Z`.

params.name: event_id
params.description: It is the conversion event UUID from Ads Manager, not a per-hit dedup key.
params.fix_hint: Send the conversion event ID from Ads Manager as `event_id`. Use `conversion_id` for dedup.

params.name: conversion_id
params.description: It is the per-event id used to deduplicate the pixel and the conversion API.
params.fix_hint: Send the same `conversion_id` the website tag fired.

params.name: identifiers[].twclid
params.description: X click identifier from the landing URL. One of the identifiers X requires, along with hashed email or hashed phone.
params.fix_hint: Send the `twclid` query parameter captured from the click.

params.name: identifiers[].hashed_email
params.description: Email must be trimmed, lowercased, and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Trim and lowercase the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: identifiers[].hashed_phone_number
params.description: Phone must be normalized to E.164 and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Normalize to E.164, hash with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: identifiers[].ip_address
params.description: It is the visitor IP address, sent unhashed. X documents that IP or user agent must be paired with a second identifier.
params.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address, and also send `twclid`, `hashed_email`, or `hashed_phone_number`.

params.name: identifiers[].user_agent
params.description: It is the visitor user agent, sent unhashed.
params.fix_hint: Send the browser's user agent string, not a digest.

params.name: price_currency
params.description: It is an ISO 4217 currency code.
params.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

params.name: value
params.description: The direct example uses a decimal string; the official sender emits native numbers, including signed and exponent values. No nonnegative-only restriction is inferred.
params.fix_hint: Send `value` as a decimal string, such as `20.00`.

params.name: number_items
params.description: It is the number of items in the conversion. X documents `number_items` on the conversion object.
params.fix_hint: Send `number_items` as an integer, such as `3`.

params.name: description
params.description: It is a short description of the conversion. X documents `description` on the conversion object.
params.fix_hint: Send `description`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: contents[].content_id
params.description: It is the product id on a contents row. X documents `content_id` on each contents object.
params.fix_hint: Set `contents[].content_id` to the SKU or catalog id, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: contents[].content_name
params.description: It is the product name on a contents row. X documents `content_name` on each contents object.
params.fix_hint: Set `contents[].content_name` to the product name, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: contents[].content_type
params.description: It is the product category on a contents row. X documents `content_type` on each contents object.
params.fix_hint: Set `contents[].content_type` to the category, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: contents[].content_price
params.description: The direct example uses a decimal string; the official sender emits native numbers, including signed and exponent values. No nonnegative-only restriction is inferred.
params.fix_hint: Send `contents[].content_price` as a number, such as `100.99`. Put the order total in `value`.

params.name: contents[].num_items
params.description: It is the quantity of that product. X documents `num_items` on each contents object.
params.fix_hint: Send `contents[].num_items` as an integer, such as `1`.

params.name: contents[].content_group_id
params.description: It is the product group id on a contents row. X documents `content_group_id` on each contents object.
params.fix_hint: Set `contents[].content_group_id`, or drop the empty pair.

params.description: Each conversions entry is an object.

params.name: conversion_timestamp
params.description: The pinned official sender emits a native millisecond timestamp. No receiver age bound is inferred.

params.name: event_name
params.description: The official sender uses gtm_ plus the incoming name when Event ID is unset. The event vocabulary stays open.

params.name: event_source_url
params.description: The official sender forwards page_location as event_source_url. No URL-only rejection policy is inferred from this forwarded value.

params.name: identifiers
params.description: Identity entries use an array in the direct API and the official sender.

params.name: identifiers[]
params.description: Each identifier entry is an object. Multiple fields may share an entry.

params.name: identifiers[].twpid
params.description: The official sender forwards the first-party _twpid cookie unhashed. Cookie authenticity is external.

params.name: contents
params.description: Optional product contents use an array.

params.name: contents[]
params.description: Each optional product entry is an object. Empty objects and future fields remain open.

rules.message: The conversion has no click ID, Pixel cookie, hashed email or hashed phone. The direct guide and GTM guide differ on IP plus user-agent-only matching; that pair receives separate advice.
rules.fix_hint: Add a `twclid`, a SHA-256 hashed email, or a SHA-256 hashed phone number.

rules.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. X requires email as `hashed_email`, SHA-256 hashed on the client side.
rules.fix_hint: Trim the address, lowercase it, hash it with SHA-256, and send it as `hashed_email`.

rules.message: This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but X documents `ip_address` and `user_agent` as unhashed.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address or user agent. Hashing it makes the event unmatchable.

rules.message: Only IP and user agent are supplied. The direct guide allows this pair but the GTM guide recommends a strong identifier; matching cannot be established locally.

params.name: conversion_time
params.description: A legacy conversion needs conversion_time when the official sender timestamp is absent.

params.name: event_id
params.description: A conversion needs event_id when the official sender event_name is absent.

rules.message: Check the conversion timestamp calendar, time and timezone. Prefix matching alone does not establish a valid timestamp.
Supply the direct API authorization header or the official GTM X-Pixel-Token. Header presence does not prove credential validity.
